leads.interested_course_name: SAP ABAP on HANA & RESTful Application Programming (RAP)

leads.notes: Wants weekend batches with SAP server access

courses.description: Comprehensive Financial Accounting and Controlling on SAP S/4HANA with live enterprise implementation scenarios and S/4HANA migration projects.
End-to-end Procurement, Inventory Management, Logistics Invoice Verification (LIV), and Master Data Governance (MDG).
Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle, Pricing Procedures, Shipping, Credit Management, and S/4HANA Sales integration.

courses.course_name: SAP ABAP on HANA & RESTful Application Programming (RAP)
courses.description: Modern ABAP 7.5+, Core Data Services (CDS Views), AMDP, OData services, SAP Fiori elements, and RAP architecture.

modules.title: Module 1: Enterprise Structure & General Ledger
modules.description: Company Code, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal Year Variants, and Document Posting

modules.title: Module 2: Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable
modules.description: Vendor/Customer Master, Automatic Payment Program (F110), and Dunning

lessons.title: 1.1 Introduction to SAP S/4HANA Architecture & Navigation
lessons.text_content: SAP S/4HANA represents the next-generation ERP suite. Key changes include in-memory computing, Universal Journal (ACDOCA), and real-time financial reporting.

lessons.title: 1.2 Configuring Enterprise Structure (OX02, OX15, OX16)
lessons.text_content: Step-by-step configuration of Company, Company Code, Credit Control Area, and assignments.

lessons.title: Module 1 Blueprint Handout & Configuration Guide
lessons.text_content: Comprehensive PDF reference documentation for Enterprise Structure setup.

classSessions.topic: Financial Statement Version (FSV) & General Ledger Configuration
Purchase Requisition to Purchase Order Workflow & Pricing Schema

assignments.title: Company Code & Chart of Accounts Configuration Exercise
assignments.description: Configure a new global enterprise model with 2 Company Codes, operational chart of accounts, and fiscal year variant K4 in the SAP sandbox.

submissions.submission_text: Completed configuration for Company Code IN10 and US10 with Chart of Accounts CAIN. Screenshots and transport request logs attached.
submissions.feedback: Excellent configuration clarity. Posting period variant is correctly mapped.

quizzes.title: SAP FICO Module 1 Certification Assessment
quizzes.description: Assessment testing General Ledger concepts, Document Splitting, and S/4HANA ACDOCA table architecture.

quizQuestions.question_text: Which table in SAP S/4HANA serves as the Universal Journal containing both FI and CO line items?
quizQuestions.explanation: ACDOCA is the Universal Journal table in SAP S/4HANA unifying general ledger, asset accounting, controlling, and profitability analysis.

quizQuestions.question_text: Is Business Partner (BP) mandatory for creating Customers and Vendors in SAP S/4HANA?
quizQuestions.explanation: Yes, in S/4HANA, traditional transactions like XD01 and XK01 redirect to transaction BP (Business Partner).

messages.message: When running transaction F-28, document splitting rule fails for zero-balance clearing.
Please check your document splitting characteristics in IMG > Financial Accounting > General Ledger > Business Transactions.

doubts.title: Error F5151: Company code 1000 is not defined in transaction FB50
doubts.description: When I try to post a GL document in FB50 for company code 1000, the system displays error F5151 saying company code is not fully defined. I completed OX02 and OX16.

messages.message: When I try to post a GL document in FB50 for company code 1000, the system displays error F5151 saying company code is not fully defined. I completed OX02 and OX16.

Hi Amit, please check transaction OBY6 (Company Code Global Parameters) to ensure the fiscal year variant (e.g. V3) and chart of accounts (INT) are assigned to company code 1000. Also verify OB52 for open posting periods.
